Alice Martin: Hey support — after we rolled out the new IdP change this morning, three engineers report 403 when opening the project console. They used to be project admins. :confused:
Priya Shah: Sorry — can you DM the org and project id? Also do you know if the SCIM sync was enabled/changed recently?
Alice Martin: Org: org_42, Project: payments-ui. SCIM was enabled, and the IdP team said they started prefixing groups with "dept:" for clarity.
Priya Shah: Hm. That'd cause group name mismatch with our role mappings which are exact-match. Can you confirm they still appear in your SCIM group list (maybe with and without prefix)?
Alice Martin: I see both variants in the IdP console — old group "payments-admins", new "dept:payments-admins". We see members in both.
Priya Shah: OK. Two likely causes: 1) Our group->role mapping is still bound to "payments-admins" only, so members in the prefixed group won't inherit admin role. 2) SCIM sync may have deactivated the old group and created a new one, leaving mapping orphaned.
Priya Shah: Quick workaround: add a role mapping for "dept:payments-admins" to project-admin. Long-term we should either update mappings or strip the prefix on provisioning.
Alice Martin: How can we add that mapping? I don't see a UI entry.
Priya Shah: I can add it from our side if you want. Alternatively you can push a SCIM patch to include an exact group externalId. Example API call we use:
```
PATCH /v1/orgs/org_42/group-mappings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "group_name": "dept:payments-admins",
  "role": "project-admin",
  "project_id": "proj_pay_ui"
}
```
Priya Shah: If you prefer we can do it — but I need an owner confirm. @Jordan Li can you approve on infra side if it's safe to add mapping for prefixed groups?
Jordan Li: Approving. Also going to check SCIM audit to see if old group was deleted and re-created (we've seen that pattern cause orphaned mappings).
idp-bot: SCIM sync ran at 2024-12-08T09:06:12Z — created group "dept:payments-admins" (externalId: grp-9987), deactivated group "payments-admins" (externalId: grp-234)
Ben S.: FYI if you want to avoid this class of issues, we can enable group-aliasing on our side so mappings treat prefix-insensitive names for a short window.
Alice Martin: Please go ahead with adding mapping from your side, that would be fastest. Also would it break anything to alias names?
Priya Shah: Adding mapping now — will post when complete. Alias would be safe for 48h while you coordinate IdP changes.
Priya Shah: Done — I've added mapping for dept:payments-admins -> project-admin on proj_pay_ui. Can you verify? :white_check_mark:
Alice Martin: Just checked — access restored for the three engineers. Thanks!
Priya Shah: Great. Next steps: we'll leave aliasing enabled for 48h and Jordan will follow up with SCIM audit details and recommendation (rename or strip prefix upstream). I'll also note this in the support ticket for future reference.
Jordan Li: SCIM audit shows old group was deactivated rather than mapped, so mapping lost. We'll suggest provisioning update to keep externalId stable.
Alice Martin: Thanks everyone — big help :pray:
Priya Shah: Glad we could help. Closing the thread if no other impacted projects. :slightly_smiling_face:
